products.title: Train the right way
products.subtitle: From photo-realism to document format, we cover the full spectrum of digital training.

items.title: WiseTour, captured from your facilities
items.description: 360° tours created from real photos of your sites. The most faithful rendering possible, as if you were there.
items.process: Already have a scan (.ply, .sog, .splat)? Upload it into the editor. Otherwise our technicians capture your facilities, or you film with your smartphone and we take care of the rest
items.interaction: Free and immersive navigation, interaction via points of interest
items.price: Editor: +€900/yr with your scan. Scan by our team: €10,000 to €20,000 depending on the site

items.title: WiseTrainer, custom-built in 3D
items.description: Your workshops modeled in 3D with a high level of detail. Interactive, gamified, with complete training scenarios.
items.deployment: ~1 month for the 3D asset, then ~1 day per scenario
items.process: Share your plans and references via our secure platform or your own access procedures. The 3D asset belongs to you
items.interaction: Full interaction: object manipulation, gamified scenarios, hazardous situation simulation
items.price: Custom project: €5,000 to €15,000 depending on the scope

items.title: WisePaper, your documents turned into trainings
items.description: Import your PDF, Word or PowerPoint files. Our AI converts them into interactive courses with quizzes and completion tracking.
items.process: Content automatically generated by AI from your existing files. Replace the document, the training updates
items.price: Editor included in the LMS core, unlimited trainings and authors. AI import of your documents: +€600/yr

items.title: Ask AI, your safety copilot
items.description: Photo-based risk hunts, an incident database searchable in natural language and prevention reports: the platform's AI works on your field reality.
items.process: The AI cross-references your internal accident history, public accident databases and your training catalog
items.interaction: Chat, workstation photo analysis, dated PDF reports
items.price: Ask AI brick: +€900/yr within the platform. Photo-based risk hunt: +€600/yr

advantages.title: Let's build your digital asset together
advantages.subtitle: What makes the WiseTwin difference

reactivity.label: Reactive
reactivity.title: Reactivity at every moment
reactivity.description: Our solutions can be deployed instantly for the simplest ones, up to 1 month for the most complex. React quickly after an incident, train your teams without delay.

tracking.label: Traceability
tracking.title: Every answer is tracked
tracking.description: Every action of your learners is recorded and analyzable. Identify gaps, measure progress and make informed decisions about your training plans.

costEffective.label: Competitive
costEffective.title: 80% of the effectiveness for 20% of the price
costEffective.description: Our simulators offer immersion comparable to high-end VR solutions, at a fraction of the cost. We focus on the essentials to train your teams effectively without the superfluous.

easyIntegration.label: Integrable
easyIntegration.title: Integrates with your existing tools
easyIntegration.description: Import your SCORM 1.2 and 2004 trainings and send your training data as xAPI statements to the LRS of your choice (Moodle, 360Learning, Talentsoft). No break in your training ecosystem.

noEquipment.label: Light
noEquipment.title: Zero equipment, zero constraint
noEquipment.description: No need for Oculus, HTC Vive or other expensive VR equipment. A PC and an internet connection are enough. Your learners train directly from their web browser.

included.title: Your place, or ours: you choose
included.description: The LMS platform delivers, tracks and steers your trainings, SCORM included, and is modular by bricks: the WisePaper and WiseTour editors, Ask AI and the risk hunt, SSO and API integrations, white label. From €1,200/year, €4,800/year all included excluding SSO.
